author: That1gamer12
quote: The game looks amazing, and that’s about where it ends. Everything shown feels like Rockstar traded the gritty GTA I grew up with for cringey characters and a watered-down story. GTA used to be about chaos, crime, and dark humor. Now it feels like they’re more worried about making a statement than making a good game. I don’t want lectures; I want GTA. Great graphics can’t save bad writing.
